title: The relay ledger has a waiting phase, so a run waiting on the owner is not stale

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: `relay-run` marks a run stale 30 minutes after the last step event (`STALE_AFTER`, `src/slicer/relayrun.py:49`). A run that waits for owner approval or an owner answer is not stale. ork's S78 waited at awaiting-approval and showed as "stale ... 23m", so it looked dead (ork S138, 2026-10-26). `slicer land` also refuses `run_active` only while a run is not stale, so staleness carries meaning.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Add `--phase wait` (with an optional `--waiting-on owner|approval`) to `relay-run step`. A waiting step never makes its run stale, and `relay-run list` shows it as waiting. Align with s396's ask and answer.
